summary: Degrade observer health after sustained local budget deferral

schema.detail: Uses existing healthy/degraded states and local plugin metadata; no wire or storage schema change.

rules.detail: Local budget deferrals become degraded when no provider poll has completed for more than max(three effective poll intervals including standing backoff, thirty minutes). Every successful poll resets freshness, including unchanged facts. Observers that have never completed use their first local polling time. Local budget deferral alone does not require a person.

compatibility.detail: The local freshness clock survives daemon restart. Budget errors retain their reason, error code and next-check deadline. This exposes stale observations; it does not change request admission or guarantee polling progress.

recovery.detail: Older binaries ignore the additional local metadata.
